name: American Water Resources / Oncourse Home Solutions
notes: Researched from the public Oncourse Home Solutions FAQs and the public sign-in page only (never signed in). American Water Resources (awrusa.com) now points to Oncourse Home Solutions. Sign-in (Azure B2C) shows Email Address and Password, Sign in, Forgot your password? and Sign up now. Plans are 12-month terms that renew automatically at then-current rates; payment by Visa or Mastercard, check or ACH, monthly or annually; some customers are billed on their utility bill (not modelled). Automatic payment is chosen at enrollment; turning it off online is not described, so autopay_cancel is modelled as unsupported with the 24/7 number (inferred). Cancellation is by phone only (1-855-800-5195, 24/7, choose the cancel option): full refund within 30 days of enrollment; monthly payers end at the end of the billing cycle with no refund; annual payers get a refund for the rest of the term. Renewal and other questions can also go by text to 630-534-9190. Moved from utility-account to streaming like HomeServe and AHS: this is a protection-plan subscription, not a metered utility. The online account's features are not described publicly; the family's pages stay. Plan prices vary by ZIP and are not published, so the plan page keeps synthetic plans. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (independent review): FAQ re-read (payment options, auto-renewal, text renewals, cancellation refunds, failed payments); contact page confirms existing-customer line 1-855-800-5195 (24/7) and new-customer line 1-877-513-8520.

sources.title: Oncourse Home Solutions FAQs | Home Warranty Questions

autopay.note: With automatic payment on file, your plan renews every 12 months at the then-current rate; you get a reminder before it expires.

autopay_cancel.note: To change how your plan is paid or stop automatic renewal, call 1-855-800-5195 (24/7) or text 630-534-9190.

cancel_service.note: Call 1-855-800-5195 any time, day or night, and choose the cancel option. Cancel within 30 days of enrollment for a full refund.

help.title: Paying for your protection plan
paragraphs: You can pay by Visa or Mastercard, by check or by ACH bank transfer, monthly or once a year. Depending on where you live and your utility, you may be able to add your plan to your utility bill.
If a payment fails, Oncourse could not charge the payment method on file. Contact them to set up another payment method so your coverage stays active.

help.title: Renewals
paragraphs: Coverage runs for 12 months and renews automatically each year at the then-current rate. If you chose auto-renewal at enrollment, you do not need to do anything.

Otherwise, renew by calling 1-855-800-5195 (24/7) or texting 630-534-9190. A reminder arrives by email or mail before your coverage expires; if you do not have an automatic payment method and do not respond, your coverage ends.

help.title: Cancel your plan
paragraphs: Call 1-855-800-5195 any time, choose the cancel option and tell the agent you want to cancel.

Cancel within 30 days of enrollment for a full refund of program fees, issued within 30 days. After that, monthly payers' cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing cycle with no refund; annual payers' cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing month and the rest of the term is refunded to the original payment method.
If you pay on your utility bill, Oncourse tells the utility; a charge may still appear on one or two more utility bills. Coverage stays active until the cancellation takes effect.

extra.intent: You want to renew your Oncourse protection plan by text message. Using the FAQs, find the number to text. Do not make a payment or change anything.
Using the Oncourse FAQs, find within how many days of enrollment you must cancel to get a full refund. Do not cancel anything.
